text:
Tyler Ross: Quick note  final loop for Lourdes Martinez is next Wed 2:00pm PT onsite. Lourdes asked about a private lactation/pumping room and a place to store expressed milk. Also asked whether we can cover childcare for the travel day and whether we provide an electric outlet adapter (she has a US-to-UK pump plug). Can people-ops confirm?

Aisha Khan: Im on panel 2:00-3:15 and can be flexible. We should accommodate the pumping breaks without disrupting the loop.

people-ops: Hi team  yes we can provide a dedicated lactation room and a refrigerated storage container for expressed milk. We can also provide an electrical adapter and an outlet-safe surge protector. Childcare stipend policy: up to $200 reimbursement or we can issue a prepaid card if candidate prefers. Which option does Lourdes want?

Tyler Ross: She prefers a prepaid card if possible. Also asked if we can schedule a 20-min buffer in the middle for pumping without cutting any interviewer time. Can we compress the schedule slightly or provide an overlapping panel?

people-ops: We can shift the manager interview to 3:10-3:30 to create a 20-min break at 2:40. Alternatively we can have an overlap where one interviewer does a 10-min wrap while others take the break. Which would you prefer?

Aisha Khan: Overlap is fine  I can stay an extra 10 mins if needed. Would prefer we keep the total onsite time under 2 hours for travel efficiency.

facilities: Lactation room reserved  Room L1 (private, lockable) 1:45-3:45 PT. Refrigerated container with labeled slots reserved at Reception. Adapter kit (UK to US) added to the packet. We'll include a small cooler bag if she wants to transport milk home.

Tyler Ross: Thanks. @people-ops please issue the prepaid childcare card if policy allows and recruiter confirms. Also add a note in the packet about discreet check-in and a single point of contact at reception.

people-ops: We can issue a prepaid Visa card up to $200 with recruiter sign-off. Recruiter, please DM candidate consent and we'll issue the card and include it in the envelope at reception. We'll also add a printed schedule that marks the lactation room break and the reception contact.

recruiter-bot: Calendar event created: "Lourdes Martinez  Onsite Final" Wed 14:00-15:50 PT. Lactation room info, parking, and prepaid childcare instructions attached.

Tyler Ross: One more: Lourdes asked whether the coding task can be done in her own device if she prefers (to simplify logistics around milk storage). Is that permitted?

people-ops: Candidate-owned devices are allowed for non-sensitive tasks; we'll provide a guest VPN token and temporary staging account if she opts in. We'll also offer a sanitized loaner if she prefers company hardware.

Aisha Khan: If she uses her own device, please ensure we have a backup setup in case of any connectivity or browser issues. Also confirm CoderPad works with mobile hotspots.

people-ops: Confirmed  backup loaner LOAN-4439 reserved 1:30-4:00 PT. CoderPad and Zoom work over mobile hotspots; we'll provide troubleshooting tips in the packet.

candidate-ops-bot: Lactation accommodation checklist and pump adapter kit will be in the candidate envelope. Please confirm recruiter DM for prepaid childcare card issuance.

Tyler Ross: I'll DM the recruiter now. Thanks all  closing loop unless any issues. :heart:
